utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. If you know anyone handy, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — quick update: the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll send folks the new details and help line up a few helpers there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Pia — if you’re free Saturday, I’d really appreciate you stopping by to help at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting out the logistics for Saturday, but I could really use a few more helpers on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you help with the Saturday repair drive on the front porch? We still need a few extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can help with the front porch repair drive Saturday—just remind me what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’m still organizing the Saturday front porch repair drive, and I could really use a few more helpers. I’ll try to round up a couple more people too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. If you can find a couple more people, I’d be grateful.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many helpers do you still need for Saturday, and what should they bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, and we could still use a few extra helpers. Please bring simple tools and gloves if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a big help. I’m still pinning down the exact time, so I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Tess. Just send me the time when it’s set and I’ll be there Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you rounding up a few more people, and I’ll see you at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — Saturday at the front porch works, and I’m still trying to round up a couple more helpers too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia — any help you can bring on Saturday would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Uli — I’m still pinning down the porch repair drive logistics for Saturday, so a couple more helpers would really help. I’ll send the exact time as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
